(A) The qualifying fee for the positions open for election as provided by Section 1 of this

| resolution shall be $21.60 for each of the Council seats. Such fee shall be paid to the Election

Superintendent at the time a candidate files the candidate’s notice of candidacy.

(B) A pauper’s affidavit may be filed in liew of paying the qualifying fee otherwise required by this resolution in Section 2(A). A candidate filing a pauper’s affidavit instead of paying a qualifying fee shall under oath affirm the candidate’s poverty and the candidate’s resulting inability to pay the qualifying fee otherwise required. The form of the affidavit shall be as described by the Georgia Secretary of State and shall include a financial statement which lists the total income, assets, liabilities, and other relevant financial information of the candidate and
